test_cast_dtype_conversions: test SQL CAST and :: syntax for converting columns to float, integer, unsigned, string, binary, and boolean types
test_cast_error_handling: test that invalid CAST operations raise InvalidOperationError with descriptive error messages
test_try_cast_null_return: test that TRY_CAST returns null values instead of raising errors on invalid conversions
test_cast_json_parsing: test SQL CAST and :: syntax for parsing JSON strings into Polars Struct types
test_cast_format_unsupported: test that CAST with FORMAT clause raises SQLInterfaceError as it is not currently supported
